options.text: I'm in search of treasure.

steps.player: I'm in search of treasure.

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: Arr, treasure you be after eh? Well I might be able to tell you where to find some... For a price...

steps.player: What sort of price?

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: Well for example if you can get me a bottle of rum... Not just any rum mind...

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: I'd like some rum made on Karamja Island. There's no rum like Karamja Rum!
If the player has completed Rum Deal:

steps.player: Would some Braindeath 'Rum' do?

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: Gadzooks, that swill! Not a chance!

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: It's Karamja Rum or no deal.

options.text: Yes.

steps.player: Ok, I will bring you some rum.

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: Yer a saint, although it'll take a miracle to get it off Karamja.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: The Customs office has been clampin' down on the export of spirits. You seem like a resourceful young [lad/lass], I'm sure ye'll be able to find a way to slip the stuff past them.

steps.player: Well I'll give it a shot.

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: Arr, that's the spirit!

options.text: No.

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: Fair enough. I'll still be here and thirsty whenever you feel like helpin' out.

options.text: Arr!
Do you have anything for trade?

getting-started-talking-to-redbeard-fran.speaker: Redbeard Frank
getting-started-talking-to-redbeard-fran.text: Have ye brought some rum for yer ol' mate Frank?

getting-started-talking-to-redbeard-fran.speaker: Redbeard Frank
getting-started-talking-to-redbeard-fran.text: Not surprising, tis no easy task to get it off Karamja.

getting-started-talking-to-redbeard-fran.speaker: Redbeard Frank
getting-started-talking-to-redbeard-fran.text: The Customs office has been clampin' down on the export of spirits. You seem like a resourceful young lad, I'm sure ye'll be able to find a way to slip the stuff past them.

getting-started-talking-to-redbeard-fran.player: Well I'll give it another shot.

visiting-karamja-talking-to-luthas.speaker: Luthas
visiting-karamja-talking-to-luthas.text: Hello I'm Luthas, I run the banana plantation here.

options.text: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?

steps.player: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: Yes, I can sort something out. There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship.

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: You wouldn't believe the demand for bananas from Wydin's shop over in Port Sarim. I think this is the third crate I've shipped him this month..

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.

options.text: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?

steps.player: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: Well I know her pretty well. She doesn't cause me any trouble any more.

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: She doesn't even search my export crates any more. She knows they only contain bananas.

steps.player: Really? How interesting. Whereabouts do you send those to?

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: There is a little shop over in Port Sarim that buys them up by the crate. I believe it is run by a man called Wydin.

visiting-karamja-filling-the-crate-with-.text: If the player uses an individual banana on the crate:

steps.text: You pack a banana into the crate.

visiting-karamja-filling-the-crate-with-.text: If the player selects the Fill option on the crate:

steps.text: You pack all your bananas into the crate.

visiting-karamja-filling-the-crate-with-.text: If the player attempts to add an 11th banana in the crate:

steps.text: The crate is already full.

visiting-karamja-using-karamjan-rum-on-c.text: If the crate does not have a Karamjan rum already stored:

steps.text: You stash the rum in the crate.

visiting-karamja-using-karamjan-rum-on-c.text: If the player attempts to store another Karamjan rum in the crate:

steps.text: There's already some rum in here...

visiting-karamja-using-karamjan-rum-on-c.text: Pirates don't usually take banana with their Karamjan rum.
Pirates don't usually take sliced banana with their Karamjan rum.
If there are fewer than 10 bananas inside the crate:

steps.text: The crate has # banana[s] inside.
The crate is full of bananas.

visiting-karamja-using-karamjan-rum-on-c.text: If the player has hidden a rum bottle in the crate:

steps.text: There is also some rum stashed in here too.

visiting-karamja-talking-to-luthas-after.player: I've filled a crate with bananas.

options.text: Will you pay me for another crate full?

steps.player: Will you pay me for another crate full?

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: Yes certainly.

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: If you go outside you should see the old crate has been loaded on to the ship, and there is another empty crate in its place.

options.text: Thank you, I'll be on my way

steps.player: Thank you, I'll be on my way.

options.text: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?

steps.player: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?

steps.speaker: Luthas
steps.text: I sell them to Wydin who runs a grocery store in Port Sarim.

options.text: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?
Can I journey on this ship?

steps.player: Can I journey on this ship?

steps.speaker: Customs officer
steps.text: You need to be searched before you can board.

options.text: Why?

steps.player: Why?

steps.speaker: Customs officer
steps.text: Because Asgarnia has banned the import of intoxicating spirits.

options.text: Search away. I have nothing to hide.

steps.player: Search away. I have nothing to hide.

steps.text: If the player has Karamjan rum:

steps.speaker: Customs officer
steps.text: Aha, trying to smuggle rum are we?

steps.player: Umm... it's for personal use?

steps.text: The customs officer confiscates your rum.
You will need to find some way to smuggle it off the island...
If the player is wearing the Ring of Charos(a):

options.text: Umm... it's for personal use?
(Charm) This is not the Karamja rum you are looking for.

steps.player: This is not the Karamja rum you are looking for.

steps.speaker: Customs officer
steps.text: This is not the Karamja rum we are looking for.

steps.player: Well that was easy!

steps.text: The player performs the dance emote.
You dance for joy...
...and accidentally drop the rum.

steps.player: Drat...

steps.text: You will need to try again.
If the player does not have Karamjan rum:

steps.speaker: Customs officer
steps.text: Well you've got some odd stuff, but it's all legal. Now you need to pay a boarding charge of 30 coins.

options.text: Okay.

steps.player: Okay.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have 30 coins:

steps.player: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.

options.text: Oh, I'll not bother then.

steps.player: Oh, I'll not bother then.

options.text: You're not putting your hands on my things!

steps.player: You're not putting your hands on my things!

steps.speaker: Customs officer
steps.text: You're not getting on this ship then.
If the player is wearing the Ring of Charos(a):

options.text: (Charm) You don't need to look through my things.

steps.player: You don't need to look through my things.

steps.speaker: Customs officer
steps.text: Oh, I think I do. If you don't want to let me search your possessions, then you're not coming aboard this ship.

options.text: Does Karamja have unusual customs then?

steps.player: Does Karamja have any unusual customs then?

steps.speaker: Customs officer
steps.text: I'm not that sort of customs officer.

attempting-to-smuggle-out-the-rum.text: If the player teleports out using any spell or teleport item:

steps.text: The player is teleported to their target location.
Your Karamjan rum gets broken and spilled.

attempting-to-smuggle-out-the-rum.text: If the player uses Karamjan rum on an imp-in-a-box:

steps.speaker: Imp
steps.text: Don't you know? You can get into trouble for giving alcohol to minors, and I'm pretty small, it has to be said.

attempting-to-smuggle-out-the-rum.text: If the player tries to board a player owned boat

steps.text: The nearby customs agent stops you from using the dock facilities with Karamjan rum in your backpack.

retrieving-the-rum-talking-to-wydin.speaker: Wydin
retrieving-the-rum-talking-to-wydin.text: Welcome to my food store! Would you like to buy anything?

options.text: Yes please.
No, thank you.
What can you recommend?
Can I get a job here?

steps.player: Can I get a job here?

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: Well, you're keen, I'll give you that. Okay, I'll give you a go. Have you got your own white apron?
If the player has a white apron:

steps.player: Yes, I have one right here.

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: Wow - you are well prepared! You're hired. Go through to the back and tidy up for me, please.
If the white apron is not equipped:

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: You need to put your white apron on first though.
If the player does not have a white apron:

steps.player: No, I haven't.

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: Well, you can't work here unless you have a white apron. Health and safety regulations, you understand.

steps.player: Where can I get one of those?

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: Well, I get all of mine over at the clothing shop in Varrock. They sell them cheap there.

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: Oh, and I'm sure that I've seen a spare one over in Gerrant's fish store somewhere. It's the little place just north of here.

retrieving-the-rum-trying-to-open-the-do.speaker: Wydin
retrieving-the-rum-trying-to-open-the-do.text: Hey, you can't go in there. Only employees of the grocery store can go in.

options.text: Well, can I get a job here?

steps.text: Same as above from "Can I get a job here?"

options.text: Sorry, I didn't realise.

steps.player: Sorry, I didn't realise.

retrieving-the-rum-trying-to-open-the-do.speaker: Wydin
retrieving-the-rum-trying-to-open-the-do.text: Can you put your white apron on before going in there, please?

retrieving-the-rum-talking-to-wydin-afte.speaker: Wydin
retrieving-the-rum-talking-to-wydin-afte.text: Is it nice and tidy round the back now?

options.text: Yes, can I work out front now?

steps.player: Yes, can I work out front now?

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: No, I'm the one who works here.

options.text: Yes, are you going to pay me yet?

steps.player: Yes, are you going to pay me yet?

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: Umm... No, not yet.

options.text: No, it's a complete mess

steps.player: No, it's a complete mess.

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: Ah well, it'll give you something to do, won't it.

options.text: Can I buy something please?

steps.player: Can I buy something please?

steps.speaker: Wydin
steps.text: Yes, of course.

retrieving-the-rum-taking-the-apron-in-g.text: You take an apron. It feels freshly starched and smells of laundry.

retrieving-the-rum-search-crate-in-the-f.text: There are a lot of bananas in the crate.
You find your bottle of rum in amongst the bananas.

delivering-the-rum-offering-frank-stuffe.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-offering-frank-stuffe.text: Have ye brought some rum for yer ol' mate Frank?
(Frank takes the bottle from your inventory, but returns it shortly.)

delivering-the-rum-offering-frank-stuffe.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-offering-frank-stuffe.text: Arr - this here rum's got a banana stuck in it!

delivering-the-rum-offering-frank-sliced.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-offering-frank-sliced.text: Have ye brought some rum for yer ol' mate Frank?
(Frank takes the bottle from your inventory, but returns it shortly.)

delivering-the-rum-offering-frank-sliced.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-offering-frank-sliced.text: Arr - I don't likes banana in me rum!

delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.text: Have ye brought some rum for yer ol' mate Frank?
If the player does not have the rum:

steps.player: No, not yet.

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: Not surprising, tis no easy task to get it off Karamja.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: The Customs office has been clampin' down on the export of spirits. You seem like a resourceful young [lad/lass], I'm sure ye'll be able to find a way to slip the stuff past them.

steps.player: Well I'll give it another shot.

delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.text: Now a deal's a deal, I'll tell ye about the treasure. I used to serve under a pirate captain called One-Eyed Hector.

delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.text: Hector were very successful and became very rich. But about a year ago we were boarded by the Customs and Excise Agents.

delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.text: Hector were killed along with many of the crew, I were one of the few to escape and I escaped with this.
Frank happily takes the rum... and hands you a key.

delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.text: This be Hector's key. I believe it opens his chest in his old room in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.

delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-talking-to-redbeard-f.text: With any luck his treasure will be in there.

options.text: Ok thanks, I'll go and get it.

steps.player: Ok thanks, I'll go and get it.

options.text: So why didn't you ever get it?

steps.player: So why didn't you ever get it?

steps.speaker: Redbeard Frank
steps.text: I'm not allowed in the Blue Moon Inn. Apparently I'm a drunken trouble maker.

delivering-the-rum-using-the-rum-on-redb.player: Frank, I have some Karamja Rum.

delivering-the-rum-using-the-rum-on-redb.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-using-the-rum-on-redb.text: Now a deal's a deal, I'll tell ye about the treasure. I used to serve under a pirate captain called One-Eyed Hector.

delivering-the-rum-reclaiming-the-key.player: I seem to have lost my chest key...

delivering-the-rum-reclaiming-the-key.speaker: Redbeard Frank
delivering-the-rum-reclaiming-the-key.text: Arr, silly you. Fortunately I took the precaution to have another one made.
Frank hands you a chest key.

options.text: Arr!
Do you have anything for trade?

finishing-up-using-the-key-on-the-chest.text: All that's in the chest is a message...
You take the message from the chest.

finishing-up-digging-in-falador-park.speaker: Gardener
finishing-up-digging-in-falador-park.text: First moles, now this! Take this, vandal!

finishing-up-digging-in-falador-park-whi.text: I can't dig up anything with him attacking me!

finishing-up-digging-in-falador-park-a-s.text: You dig a hole in the ground...
and find a little chest of treasure.

finishing-up-using-the-chest-on-redbeard.player: I have the treasure, would you like a share?

finishing-up-using-the-chest-on-redbeard.speaker: Redbeard Frank
finishing-up-using-the-chest-on-redbeard.text: No [lad/lass], you got it fair and square.

finishing-up-using-the-chest-on-redbeard.speaker: Redbeard Frank
finishing-up-using-the-chest-on-redbeard.text: You enjoy it. It's what Hector would have wanted.

finishing-up-opening-the-casket.text: You open the casket, and find One-Eyed Hector's treasure.
